boom.name: Boom
boom.blurb: Markets are cheerful and companies are hiring.

slowdown.name: Slowdown
slowdown.blurb: Growth cools, hiring freezes and raises shrink.

crisis.name: Crisis
crisis.blurb: Markets crash, jobs get shaky and prices still rise.

provenance.basis: Illustrative four-state economy, tuned so the long-run mix is about 23% boom, 50% steady, 18% slowdown, 10% crisis. Inflation per regime averages about 5.2% across the mix; sources put India's CPI average at about 5.6% for 2012-2026 and 4.9% in the RBI inflation-targeting era (target 4%, band 2-6%; RBI and Trading Economics via secondary summaries, not checked against MoSPI). Crises last about 1.7 years on average. wageAdjPct is the extra raise (in percentage points) a fully cyclical job gets that year, averaging about zero across the mix.
